coverage: Dev 2018-2024 across 6 currencies (USD, GBP, EUR, JPY, AUD, CAD): 224 frozen USD (NFP/CPI/FOMC) + 299 T1-verified non-USD central-bank rate decisions
sources: federalreserve.gov — FOMC scheduled rate decisions 2018-2024 (14:00 America/New_York, 56 events preserved from frozen 2018_2024 JSON)
bls.gov — US Employment Situation (NFP) & Consumer Price Index (CPI) 2018-2024 (08:30 America/New_York, 168 events preserved from frozen 2018_2024 JSON)
ecb.europa.eu — ECB Governing Council monetary policy rate decisions 2018-2024 (13:45 Europe/Berlin through 2022-06-09; 14:15 Europe/Berlin effective 2022-07-21; 56 events)
bankofengland.co.uk — BoE MPC Bank Rate decisions 2018-2024 (12:00 Europe/London; 07:00 Europe/London on 2020-05-07, 2020-08-06, 2020-11-05; 2022-09-22 postponed 1 week; 56 events)

boj.or.jp — BoJ Monetary Policy Meetings 2018-2024 (including 2020 pandemic reschedules Mar 16, Apr 27, May 22, Jul 15; unfixed ~11:30-12:30 JST anchored 12:00 JST / 03:00Z with blackout_sec=3600; 57 events)
rba.gov.au — RBA Cash Rate decisions 2018-2024 (14:30 Australia/Sydney; 11 meetings/yr 2018-2023 first Tue Feb-Dec; 8 meetings/yr starting 2024; 74 events)
bankofcanada.ca — Bank of Canada policy rate announcements 2018-2024 (10:00 America/Toronto 2018-2023; 09:45 America/Toronto effective 2024-01-24; 56 events)
notes: All 224 USD timestamps from frozen red_news_official_2018_2024.json are preserved 100% verbatim.
ECB shifted publication time from 13:45 to 14:15 CET/CEST effective 2022-07-21 (verified ecb.europa.eu).
Bank of Canada shifted announcement time from 10:00 to 09:45 America/Toronto effective 2024-01-24 (verified bankofcanada.ca).

Bank of England moved three 2020 quarterly MPR/MPC releases (2020-05-07, 2020-08-06, 2020-11-05) from 12:00 to 07:00 London time, and postponed 2022-09-15 to 2022-09-22 following Queen Elizabeth II's death (verified bankofengland.co.uk).
Bank of Japan does not publish a fixed announcement minute (~11:30-12:30 JST); all 57 BoJ events anchor at 12:00 JST (03:00:00Z) with blackout_sec=3600 (+-60m) matching live naqex_red_news_meta.json.
Frozen red_news_official_2018_2024.json, red_news_official_2025_2026.json, and production naqex_red_news_utc.csv remain strictly untouched.
